description: This file defines the abstract base class and various subclasses for modeling condition elements in the Apache OFBiz widget system. It includes condition types such as 'and', 'or', 'not', 'if-compare', 'if-empty', etc., and factory methods to instantiate these condition objects based on XML element tags. The class also contains logic for evaluating the conditions based on the provided context.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing common behavior for all condition models, including a factory method for sub-condition objects and basic evaluation logic.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.And
classes.description: Represents the 'and' logical condition with a list of sub-conditions. Evaluation returns true only if all sub-conditions evaluate to true.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.DefaultConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating instances of condition objects based on XML elements, including default 'true' and 'false' singleton conditions.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfCompare
classes.description: Models the 'if-compare' condition for evaluating comparisons between a field and a value.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfCompareField
classes.description: Models the 'if-compare-field' condition for comparing two fields within the context.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfEmpty
classes.description: Models the 'if-empty' condition to test if a field value is empty.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfEntityPermission
classes.description: Models the 'if-entity-permission' condition for entity permission checks.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfHasPermission
classes.description: Models the 'if-has-permission' condition checking user permissions.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfRegexp
classes.description: Models the 'if-regexp' condition to evaluate regex match against a field.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfServicePermission
classes.description: Models the 'if-service-permission' condition for service-based permission checks.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfValidateMethod
classes.description: Models the 'if-validate-method' condition that calls a static validation method.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.Not
classes.description: Represents the 'not' logical condition which negates a sub-condition.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.Or
classes.description: Represents the 'or' logical condition with a list of sub-conditions. Evaluation returns true if any sub-condition evaluates to true.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.Xor
classes.description: Represents the 'xor' logical condition, which evaluates to true only if exactly one sub-condition evaluates to true.

methods.name: readSubConditions
methods.description: Reads child XML elements and creates a list of ModelCondition instances using the provided factory.
